$comment: How-to-obtain notes, written for this project in our own words from each item's KHWiki page (the infobox "get" or shop price for this game). wiki is the KHWiki page title. Items without "how" show only the link.

ft.riches.how: Besides enemy drops, munny comes from chests, props, selling items, Trinity Marks, and making Heartless slip on a Bouncywild's banana peel.

ft.speedster.how: The World of Chaos is fought in the End of the World; the trophy needs it beaten within 15 hours.

gm.collector.how: Blueprints drop from enemy ships, are given by Geppetto (at Heartless-defeat milestones) and Pinocchio, and reward Gummi Missions. The 1.5+2.5 trophy needs 30, while the PS3 version needed all of them.

gm.customizer.how: Build or edit a ship in the Gummi Garage with the blocks you own, staying under the block limit.

gm.mission1.how: Each world has three gummi missions; highlight a world on the world map and press Triangle to view them. Mission 1 is the easiest tier, often a score target such as 80+ for Traverse Town.

gm.mission2.how: Mission 2 goals differ per world (collecting certain blocks, kill counts, or restricted weapons), and many specify which world to set off from.

gm.mission3.how: Mission 3 is the hardest of each world's set and always rewards a blueprint; clearing every mission also earns the Bahamut ship and Crown-G.

gm.topgun.how: Routes are the flights between worlds; some contain Warp Holes that detour you onto other routes.

js.characters.how: Characters I holds the main cast and Final Fantasy characters, Characters II the Disney world characters and summons, and each Heartless entry is added once you defeat that type.

js.minigames.how: The mini-games include the Destiny Islands duels and race with Riku, the Olympus Coliseum training and cups, Deep Jungle's Jungle Slider and vine swinging, and the 100 Acre Wood games.

js.story.how: Chronicles fill in world by world as the story advances (Destiny Islands, Traverse Town and End of the World get none), alongside a Sora's Story subsection for major plot events.

kb.crabclaw.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Atlantica.

kb.divine-rose.how: Talk to Belle in the Hollow Bastion library.

kb.fairy-harp.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Neverland.

kb.jungle-king.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Deep Jungle.

kb.kingdom-key.how: Received when you talk to Riku after the Heartless attack Destiny Islands.

kb.lady-luck.how: From the White Trinity mark in Wonderland's Lotus Forest.

kb.lionheart.how: Beat Leon and Cloud in the Hades Cup.

kb.metal-chocobo.how: Beat Cloud in the Hercules Cup.

kb.oathkeeper.how: Talk to Kairi in the Secret Waterway after rescuing her.

kb.olympia.how: Chest in the Coliseum lobby, after you clear the Phil, Pegasus and Hercules Cups.

kb.pumpkinhead.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Halloween Town.

kb.spellbinder.how: Talk to Merlin once you've learned all seven first-level spells.

kb.three-wishes.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Agrabah.

kh.aw.how: Finish all of the book's stories by returning every Torn Page; the Keyhole on the book's clasp is then sealed.

kh.hb.how: On your return to Hollow Bastion, defeat the Behemoth guarding the Keyhole, then seal it.

kh.oc.how: Beat Hercules in the final round of the Hercules Cup, then seal the Keyhole using a yellow Trinity Mark.

kh.tt.how: After sealing Deep Jungle, ring the Second District bell three times to reveal the Keyhole in the fountain. Beat the Guard Armor and then the Opposite Armor to seal it.

kh.wl.how: Defeat the Trickmaster in the Bizarre Room, then seal the Keyhole hidden in the sleeping Doorknob's mouth.

kh1.puppies.how: Puppies are hidden in groups of three in chests across the worlds and go to Pongo and Perdita in Traverse Town, who hand out rewards at milestones; all 99 earns an Aero upgrade and a full gummi block set.

kh1.trinity.how: Stand on a mark with both Donald and Goofy in the party; each of the five colors is learned at a story point (e.g. Blue after the Guard Armor in Traverse Town), and most marks are optional.

lv.aero.how: Each of these gives Aero or an upgrade (Aerora, Aeroga): defeating the Opposite Armor in Traverse Town, the Yellow Trinity mark in the Ship's hold, and rescuing all 99 puppies.

lv.blizzard.how: Each of these gives Blizzard or an upgrade (Blizzara, Blizzaga): talking to the Cheshire Cat after finding the Claw Marks or defeating the Trickmaster, defeating Jafar, and defeating the Behemoth in the Hades Cup.

lv.cure.how: Each of these gives Cure or an upgrade (Cura, Curaga): defeating Clayton and the Stealth Sneak, rescuing Tinker Bell from Captain Hook, and talking to Aerith in the library three times after defeating the Behemoth.

lv.fire.how: Each of these gives Fire or an upgrade (Fira, Firaga): defeating the Guard Armor in Traverse Town, defeating Genie Jafar, and talking to the Princesses of Heart after sealing the Final Keyhole.

lv.gravity.how: Each of these gives Gravity or an upgrade (Gravira, Graviga): completing the Phil Cup, clearing Oogie's Manor, and defeating Hades in the Hades Cup.

lv.stop.how: Each of these gives Stop or an upgrade (Stopra, Stopga): defeating the Parasite Cage the second time, completing Pooh's Swing, and defeating the Phantom.

lv.thunder.how: Each of these gives Thunder or an upgrade (Thundara, Thundaga): completing Phil's training, defeating the giant Ursula, and defeating Cerberus in the Hades Cup.

mat.10.how: Dropped by Neoshadows, with a 35% chance from the seventh one you defeat.

mat.9b.how: Dropped by the Pink Agaricus; hitting it 100 times guarantees the drop.

mat.9c.how: Found in chests (Tea Party Garden, Main Street, Cemetery, Bouncing Spot, Hollow Bastion Waterway, Grand Hall, Giant Crevasse) and Trinity Marks (Hold, Chamber 6). Also won from the Pegasus Cup time trial and 10 fruits on Jade Spiral.

mat.f6.how: Dropped by Aquatanks, Screwdivers, Bambi in Deep Jungle (third gauge fill) and White Mushrooms (cast Thunder on one three times). One is also in a chest at World Terminus.

mat.fb.how: Dropped by the mushroom Heartless: White Mushrooms (cast spells on them), Black Fungus (finish with a combo) and Rare Truffles (keep juggling; 100 juggles guarantees it).
